notes.title: Now that Steam Next Fest is over - here's what's ACTUALLY Next
notes.content:
Peace and blessings upon you all,

To the thousands of people who tried the SATORI demo as part of Steam Next Fest 2021 between 06/16 - 06/22,

THANK YOU FOR OVER 6,000 DOWNLOADS!

The SATORI Next Fest demo had been extended up until Sunday, June 27, 2021, and so now the demo's online period has officially concluded. 

If you missed the demo, please join us on Discord for future demos + updates!


The number of demo downloads and the amount of positive feedback have received has been very reassuring. Thank you 🙏

What's next for SATORI?
I will be working to complete the main game loop, which is in collecting Light Seeds from one procedurally generated open-world to the next. Then some visual polish, finishing Steam features like Achievements and Statistics, and then hopefully launching at the opportune time!

Join our Discord ►
If you wish to participate in future demos and playtests, I would like to warmly invite you to join us on Discord, where regular updates and discussions will continue.

WISHLIST on Steam ►
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451970/SATORI/

Take care, everyone~

🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏

notes.title: Grind-rails massively improved + HUD update
notes.content:
Peace and blessings upon you all,

Demo Updates

 I have updated the SATORI demo with a few bug fixes, the most important one being: fixed getting stuck on grind-rails at intersections. It feels like a dream to play now that this has been fixed.
 I have also added a prototype HUD that indicates the availability of your platforming abilities. It was a quick addition, so any feedback on this is very welcome.

Important notice
As mentioned in the previous announcement, today (June 27, 2021) marks the last day you can play the SATORI demo as part of its extended period from Steam Next Fest 2021. The SATORI demo will be de-activated @ 11.59pm PST.

Thank you
The number of demo downloads and the amount of positive feedback I have received has been very reassuring. I look forward to completing the game and making the most fluid and free-flowing platforming experience available.

Join our Discord ►
If you wish to participate in future demos and playtests, I would like to warmly invite you to join us on Discord, where regular updates and discussions will continue.
